summary: Integration tests are playbooks testing playbooks, may need credentials.yml or root, and every new module or plugin should have them, marked unsupported if they can't run in CI.
questions: Does every new module need integration tests?
Where do integration test credentials go?

answer_card.title: Integration tests overview
answer_card.answer_md: Tests for playbooks, written as playbooks. Some need credentials (`credentials.yml`) or root. Every new module and plugin should have integration tests; if CI can't run them, add the `unsupported` alias.
